entities.summary: Vanathi Srinivasan is an Indian politician and a lawyer from Tamil Nadu. She has practiced law in Madras High Court since 1993. She is a member of the Tamil Nadu Legislative Assembly from Coimbatore South Assembly constituency. She currently serves as national president of the women's wing of the Bharatiya Janata Party. She is member of central election committee of party since 2022.
